Hi Monica — appreciate the deck. Quick update from our side: both security and procurement want to be present for the initial org-level demo.

- Anika (security) flagged that they need a walkthrough of data flows and KV cache/persistence behavior; she'll want ~20 minutes.
- Procurement (Mark) wants to review billing model and reserved capacity options — likely another 10–15 minutes.

Also, Liam and our product lead will be onsite/in a conference that week; the 10:00am PT slot on 4/28 collides with a standing offsite. Could we look at alternative windows the week after (5/3–5/7)? Ideally a 75-minute window so we don't rush.
